Markus / Soojin —

Summary of proposed plan from infra side (draft):
- Quiet window target: Apr 30 06:00–12:00 UTC (consistent with Acme request).
- Canary slices: 3 slices, each 20% of traffic, 20-minute soak per slice (10/20/30 minute tail depending on sequence). Canary run time ~80 minutes + buffer.
- Shelve (unpin) mechanism: we support an immediate unpin action that forces traffic routing back to last pinned model binary. Operation steps are documented in rollback-checklist.md (attached).
- Rollback RTO target: 8 minutes from detection to traffic complete shift (assumes healthy control-plane, netops approvals).
- Abort criteria (initial): error rate > 3x baseline OR latency p95 > baseline + 250ms OR KV cache invalidation observed.
- Telemetry considerations: we'll coordinate a predicate on ingest delta. If telemetry dropped >15% vs baseline, we stop and shelve.
- Approvals required: Security sign-off on audit trail + KMS ops; Support on on-call staffing; Customer success for comms.

Risks and mitigations:
- Net cutover issues: preflight BGP and netflow rehearsals with EdgeCo; propose a short netops dry-run Apr 27 23:00 UTC.
- Canary false-negatives: extend soak for slice 1 to 45m if preflight metrics variance high.

I'll attach a CSV with the exact canary timings and a short rollback-checklist.md. If this looks ok I'll mark the netops dry-run and draft the approval email.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor

Thanks Neha — added a few operational checks and a fallback ladder: 
- Preflight checklist for customer: config snapshot, KV cache checkpoint, last 24h token traffic sample exported. Request Acme to grant a 2-hour preflight window to run synthetic traffic to our canary endpoints.
- Shelve mechanics: implement a staged shelve that first snaps pins (for audit), then performs unpin + traffic drain on a per-az basis. This reduces blast radius.
- Emergency abort path: if unpin fails, we trigger a control-plane isolation and route to a cold fallback pool (read-only) while CDP restores pinned binary to a fresh set.
- Communication template: short SMS + email to customer on each stage (begin canary / canary pass / shelve / rollback). I created a draft message we can use.

I'll add my runbook sections to rollback-checklist.md and push the CSV schedule after aligning with NetOps.

-Soojin Lee
Head of Private Deployments Operations
